cenare.consejo: Regular intransitive verb of first conjugation.

texto: **In Italia si cena tardi** (In Italy it is late dinner); **In vacanza si dorme bene** (On vacation you sleep well); **Qui si lavora sodo** (Here you work hard).
In the absence of an express nominal direct complement, the verb always remains invariably in the third person of the singular: **si viaggia volentieri in treno**.

filas: In Spagna e in Italia si cena più tardi.
In Spain and Italy you will have dinner later.
In questo albergo tranquillo si dorme benissimo.
In this quiet hotel you sleep beautifully.
A teatro si entra in silenzio.
In the theater, he goes into silence.
Quando c'è rispetto si vive meglio.
When there's respect, you live better.

frases.it: Sai che in molti paesi del nord Europa si pranza a mezzogiorno?
frases.es: ¿Sabes que en muchos países del norte de Europa se almuerza a mediodía?
frases.en: Do you know that in many countries in northern Europe lunch is at noon?

frases.it: Sì, mentre da noi in Italia si cena tardi la sera.
frases.es: Sí, mientras que en nuestro país en Italia se cena tarde por la noche.
frases.en: Yes, while in our country in Italy it is late for dinner at night.

frases.it: È vero, e durante le ferie in montagna si dorme bene grazie all'aria fresca.
frases.es: Es verdad, y durante las vacaciones en la montaña se duerme bien gracias al aire fresco.
frases.en: It's true, and during the mountain holidays you sleep well thanks to the fresh air.

frases.it: Perfetto! Lì si vive tranquilli e ci si riposa davvero.
frases.es: ¡Perfecto! Allí se vive tranquilo y uno descansa de verdad.
frases.en: Perfect! There you live in peace and you really rest.

bloques.pregunta: What grammatical structure does a general custom express without specific subject?

opciones.texto: The «si» particle followed by a third-person verb singular.
opciones.explicacion: Standard of impersonal construction with intransitive verbs.

opciones.texto: El pronombre de sujeto «noi» conjugado en plural.
opciones.explicacion: It denotes a concrete collective («We»), not a generic impersonal claim.
It expresses individual action of its own, other than generalizations.

bloques.frase: In Italia la sera generalmente ___ tardi rispetto al nord Europa.

opciones.explicacion: Third-person intransitive verb of the singular with the impersonal particle «si».
Plural concordance error; intransitive verbs require singular.
I would express «We have dinner.», losing the generic value.

bloques.pregunta: What quality does the phrase stand out?
bloques.frase: In questo hotel di campagna si dorme benissimo.

opciones.texto: You will enjoy a wonderful and restorative dream in this establishment.
opciones.explicacion: Translation of impersonal construction with the verb «dormire».

opciones.texto: The hotel is closed during the hottest months of summer.
opciones.explicacion: It contrasts the reference to accommodation and night rest.

opciones.texto: Guests should wake up early by the rules of the premises.

bloques.pregunta: How do you say «in this restaurant you eat well»?

opciones.texto: In questo ristorante si mangia bene.
In questo ristorante si mangiano bene.
opciones.explicacion: Plural is wrong because there is no plural receiving object.

opciones.texto: In questo ristorante noi mangia bene.
opciones.explicacion: A plural pronoun agramatical combination with singular verb.

bloques.explicacion: Order the impersonal phrase about time habits.

bloques.frase: Quando si è stanchi, ___ volentieri per recuperare le energie.

opciones.explicacion: Impersonal singular that logically matches the tiredness condition.
Insufficient plural form with intransitive verb of state.
It is a second plural person («dormís»), alien to impersonality.

bloques.pregunta: What describes the «in vacanza si vive meglio» expression?

opciones.texto: A universal assessment of the quality of life in the holiday period.
A complaint from a private tourist about the accommodation prices.
A mandatory order addressed to the employees of a business.
opciones.explicacion: It conforms a general statement with an imperative mandate.

intro: When talking about collective customs, social norms or shared habits without specifying a particular person, Italian uses impersonal construction with the **si** particle followed by a third-person verb of the singular.
